QuestInfo.name: [Azmoth Chasm] What Lies in Azmoth
QuestInfo.0: Your first trip into Azmoth certainly reveals a few truths. Time to report to Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce suspects the demons of Tynerum were conducting research in Azmoth. However, the creatures inside hardly seem like the purposeful product of experimentation.
QuestInfo.2: Athena Pierce said there's plenty left to find in the chasm, and promised she'd begin exploring it as well.
